description: A price mismatch against a Rate Card cost: the Carrier claims 10% more than the Carrier cost, whose source is a Carrier Rate Card version. Known answer: Price mismatch; the explanation gives the claimed amount, the agreed amount, the difference and the tolerance and says the price came from a Rate Card version; it cannot resolve by itself; the agent suggests accept-adjusted or leaves it to a person. Never reject (a Price mismatch has an Open Carrier cost to accept against) and never plain accept (only when the invoiced amount is shown to be right).

setup.seed: Take a delivered Booking of CAR-0001 priced from a Carrier Rate Card to an Open Carrier cost with the reference CB-20418 and a total of EUR 500.00. Submit the Carrier invoice EVAL-PRICE-RC-1 of CAR-0001 with one line CB-20418 for EUR 550.00.

input: Explain why the line "CB-20418" of Carrier invoice "EVAL-PRICE-RC-1" of Carrier "CAR-0001" did not match, and whether it may still resolve.

explanation.rubric: Says the line is a Price mismatch: EUR 550.00 claimed against EUR 500.00 agreed, a difference of EUR 50.00, and that the agreed price comes from a Rate Card version. Says the line does not resolve by itself. Does not guess why the Carrier's price differs.
